verdict.rationale: Zulip is a team chat product, so AI-generated meeting and huddle recaps are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has nothing on calls, huddles, transcription, or AI-generated notes or recaps. The interactive bot framework and integrations are only developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated notes and recaps from meetings and huddles I attended or missed
